title: Deep Learning Applications in Healthcare: A Comprehensive Review
abstract: This paper surveys the latest advances in deep learning for medical imaging, diagnosis, and treatment planning. We examine convolutional neural networks, recurrent architectures, and transformer models applied to healthcare datasets.

title: Machine Learning for Predictive Healthcare: Challenges and Opportunities
abstract: We present a framework for applying machine learning to predictive healthcare analytics. This work addresses data quality, model interpretability, and clinical validation challenges in real-world deployments.

title: Ethical Considerations in AI-Driven Medical Decision Support Systems
abstract: This paper examines ethical frameworks for AI systems in clinical settings, including bias mitigation, transparency, and accountability. We propose guidelines for responsible AI deployment in healthcare.

title: Transformer Models for Biomedical Text Mining and Knowledge Extraction
abstract: We demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based models for extracting clinical insights from unstructured medical literature. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on biomedical NLP benchmarks.
journal: ACM Transactions on Computing for Healthcare

title: Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Healthcare Analytics
abstract: We propose a federated learning framework that enables collaborative healthcare analytics while preserving patient privacy. Our system achieves comparable accuracy to centralized approaches without sharing raw data.
journal: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics

title: Interpretable Machine Learning Models for Clinical Risk Prediction
abstract: This work develops interpretable ML models for predicting patient outcomes. We compare SHAP values, LIME, and attention mechanisms to provide clinicians with explainable predictions.

title: Graph Neural Networks for Drug Discovery and Molecular Analysis
abstract: We apply graph neural networks to molecular property prediction and drug-target interaction modeling. Our approach outperforms traditional cheminformatics methods on benchmark datasets.
journal: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling

title: Attention Mechanisms in Medical Image Segmentation: A Survey
abstract: We survey attention-based architectures for medical image segmentation tasks. This comprehensive review covers self-attention, channel attention, and spatial attention mechanisms.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Personalized Treatment Planning
abstract: We develop reinforcement learning algorithms for optimizing personalized treatment strategies. Our approach learns from historical patient data to recommend tailored interventions.

title: Multimodal Learning for Comprehensive Patient Assessment
abstract: We present a multimodal learning framework that integrates imaging, genomic, and clinical data for holistic patient assessment. Our model achieves superior predictive performance.

title: Adversarial Robustness in Medical AI Systems
abstract: We investigate adversarial attacks on medical AI systems and propose defense mechanisms. Our work highlights vulnerabilities in deployed models and provides practical mitigation strategies.
journal: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

title: Continual Learning for Evolving Healthcare Datasets
abstract: We address the challenge of continual learning in healthcare where data distributions shift over time. Our approach prevents catastrophic forgetting while adapting to new patient populations.
